name: Promobot V.4
summary: An autonomous service robot with a humanoid torso, two 6–7 DOF arms and a chest touchscreen on a wheeled base, sold by Promobot (founded 2015 in Perm, Russia; now US-headquartered) for reception, tour-guide and administrative roles in airports, banks and museums. A realistic-faced variant, Robo-C, uses the same platform.
notable: One of Europe's most widely sold service humanoids
Deployed as a front-desk civil servant in Russia
